strings.off_no_crucible: Wildblood is off: this server does not run Meadworks.
strings.off_no_wildblood: Wildblood is off: this server does not run Wildblood.
strings.luck_client_only: Wildblood is off on this server; your bad-luck protection is still saved.
strings.import_done: Imported {0} settings from {1}. The original files are unchanged.
strings.step_aside_stars: Wildblood stars are off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_traits: Wildblood traits are off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_bosses: Wildblood bosses are off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_loot: Wildblood loot is off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_luck: Wildblood luck is off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_pressure: Wildblood pressure is off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_recap: Wildblood recap is off while {0} is installed. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_horde: Wildblood Horde is off while {0} is active. Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_pressure_scaling: Wildblood per-player difficulty is off while {0} is installed. The game's values stay as {0} sets them.
strings.pressure_scaling_external: Another mod changed the multiplayer difficulty values; Wildblood leaves them alone.
strings.recap_no_video: No video recorded. Hit details remain available.
strings.board_help: damage: show the latest boss damage board.
strings.board_unavailable: Boss board is unavailable in this session.
strings.board_none: No boss damage board is available in this world.
strings.board_waiting: Requesting the latest boss damage board…
strings.board_timeout: The boss board request timed out. Use damage to try again.
strings.lore_example: Live rules for an ordinary 1-star creature in {0}. Creature-specific rules may differ.
strings.lore_global: Global modifier rules. Creature, biome and source rules may differ.
strings.lore_boss_rules: Live boss rules. Per-boss rules may differ.
strings.lore_none: Nothing to show while this module is off.
strings.lore_prose_note: Rule descriptions are shown in English.
strings.lore_help: wildblood lore: open the Wildblood page of the Compendium. wildblood reference: write creature_reference.yml for this world.
strings.lore_unavailable: The Wildblood lore is unavailable in this session.
strings.lore_reference_failed: Could not write the creature reference; see the log.
strings.lore_reference_world: The creature reference needs a loaded world.
strings.lore_help_more: wildblood tier: world tier and local star odds. wildblood inspect: the creature under the crosshair. wildblood theft [status|recover]: your retained thefts; recover asks the creature's owner. Admins: wildblood effects <text>. With Creature Commands on: wildblood spawn <prefab> <stars> [traits], wildblood purge [radius], wildblood karma [value].
strings.theft_phase_unknown: outcome unknown, item kept stolen until answered
strings.theft_legacy: (older request: kept until resolved by hand)
strings.theft_recover_done: Creature owners asked: {0}. Not reachable now: {1}. Older requests left unchanged: {2}.
strings.theft_unavailable: Wildblood theft records are unavailable in this session.
strings.inspect_locked: wildblood inspect is for admins only on this server (Players May Inspect is off).
strings.commands_off: Creature Commands is switched off. An admin can turn it on in the Cheats settings.
strings.spawn_modifier_dropped: wildblood spawn: modifier {0} dropped; a mutation with the same effect wins.
strings.spawn_modifiers_unresolved: wildblood spawn: modifiers not applied; the creature was gone or not ready within 10 seconds.
strings.raid_tier_invalid: '{0}' is not a raid tier. Use 0 (leather) to 7 (Deep North), or leave it out to use the strongest nearby player's gear.
strings.step_aside_ai: Player target switching steps aside for {0}.
strings.lore_help_tabmutations: Read creature mutation effects and their current values. This tab does not change world rules.
strings.lore_help_tabmodifiers: Read creature modifier effects and their current values. This tab does not change world rules.
strings.lore_help_tabaspects: Read boss aspect effects and their current values. This tab does not change world rules.
strings.lore_help_tabdifficulty: Read the active difficulty settings. This tab does not change them.
strings.lore_help_previous: Show the previous page in this lore tab. Stops at the first page.
strings.lore_help_next: Show the next page in this lore tab. Stops at the last page.
strings.lore_help_close: Close the read-only lore window without changing world rules.
strings.recap_help_older: Select an older recorded death. Playback pauses and returns to the beginning of that recording.
strings.recap_help_newer: Select a newer recorded death. Playback pauses and returns to the beginning of that recording.
strings.recap_help_play: Play or pause the selected recording. Play restarts a recording that has reached its end. Requires a recorded death.
strings.recap_help_back: Move back one second in the selected recording, stopping at its beginning. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.recap_help_forward: Move forward one second in the selected recording, stopping at its end. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.recap_help_death: Jump to the moment of death in the selected recording and pause playback.
strings.recap_help_previous_hit: Jump to the previous recorded hit and pause playback. Stops at the first hit.
strings.recap_help_next_hit: Jump to the next recorded hit and pause playback. Stops at the last hit.
strings.recap_help_close: Close the recap window and stop playback. Recorded deaths are kept.
strings.recap_help_time: Enter a clip time in seconds within the selected recording. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.recap_help_timeline: Drag through the selected recording from start to end. Seeking pauses playback.
strings.karma_quote_02: You cannot run from your shadow.
strings.enforcer_spawn_01: Even your death is not enough.
strings.enforcer_death_03: My death only weighs you down.
strings.enforcer_warning: Run while you can. I grant you {0} seconds.
strings.status_adrenaline_drain_tooltip: Current adrenaline and adrenaline gain reduced.
strings.status_corrosive_tooltip: Equipped armor, weapon, and shield durability loss increased.
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Whole product. Off: creatures, loot and luck behave as the game does.
strings.cfg_1_general__stars_enabled_help: Creature stars and difficulty. Off: creatures spawn with the game's levels.
strings.cfg_1_general__traits_enabled_help: Mutations and modifiers on creatures. Off: no new traits roll.
strings.cfg_1_general__bosses_enabled_help: Boss aspects, boss stars, trophies, damage board and hints.
strings.cfg_1_general__loot_enabled_help: Wildblood loot rules for starred creatures. Off: creatures drop the game's loot.
strings.cfg_1_general__protected_prefabs_help: Comma list of prefabs that are never starred, traited or scaled. Creatures already rolled keep what they rolled.
strings.cfg_2_stars__difficulty_help: Star caps, star odds and mutation rates by biome and world tier: Easy, Medium, Hard, VeryHard, Extreme, or Custom (the rule file's biome rows).
strings.cfg_2_stars__star_mode_help: Wildblood rolls stars; KeepExisting keeps the level the game or another mod gave; Off rolls no stars.
strings.cfg_2_stars__max_stars_help: Most stars a creature can roll.
strings.cfg_2_stars__distance_scaling_help: Health and damage (and modifier chances) rise with distance from the world center, by the distanceScaling bands in the rule file. Default band: +3% damage and +8% health per 1000 m, up to 5 steps.
strings.cfg_2_stars__scale_saddle_able_creatures: Off: creatures that take a saddle keep their size at any star count.
strings.cfg_2_stars__respect_enemy_level_up_rate: The world modifier for enemy level-up rate scales star odds.
strings.cfg_3_world_tier__enabled_help: The world hardens one tier each time a listed boss first falls.
strings.cfg_3_world_tier__boss_keys_help: Comma list of global keys that each add one tier.
strings.cfg_3_world_tier__announce_help: Show "The world hardens" when the tier rises.
strings.cfg_4_traits__max_mutations_help: Most mutations one creature carries; 0 means no limit.
strings.cfg_4_traits__creature_modifiers_help: Most modifiers a creature carries, at most one per group. Max1 to Max4: up to that many; Off: none.
strings.cfg_4_traits__large_star_power_help: Multiplier of E-marked mutation numbers on creatures with five or more stars.
strings.cfg_4_traits__blink_alert_grace_help: Seconds after a Blinking creature is alerted before it may blink.
strings.cfg_4_traits__reflection_damage_cap_help: Most health an attacker loses per reflection; 0 means no cap.
strings.cfg_4_traits__tamed_keep_traits_help: Taming keeps a creature's traits (tamed variants apply). Off: while a creature is tamed its mutations and modifiers do not act; they stay stored, and its stars stay. Young born while this is off inherit no mutation.
strings.cfg_4_traits__tamed_stars_help: On: a new birth may inherit stars, and Shepherd follows this when it is installed. Off: a newborn keeps its parent's level, as the game does, and no bonus star is added. Taming never removes stars, health, or mutations. A creature an older build left at the game's level gets its stored stars back the next time it loads. The server sets this.
strings.cfg_4_traits__players_may_inspect_help: Host rule: every player may run wildblood inspect, which lists the stars, traits and resulting values of the creature under the crosshair. It only reads, so it is not a cheat. Off: admins only.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__boss_stars_help: Bosses roll stars on their own table.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__aspects_help: Bosses take an aspect at their altar or on appearance.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__altar_shift_seconds_help: Seconds between altar aspect shifts; 0 never shifts.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__boss_modifiers_help: Most modifiers a boss carries. Max1 to Max4: up to that many; Off (default): none, so bosses have only their aspects.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__damage_board_help: Show each player's damage when a boss dies.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__boss_hints_help: Server rule: allows hints that point players near a fallen boss toward the next point of interest. Players can still hide them with Display / Boss Hints.
strings.cfg_5_bosses__block_spawns_near_boss_hel: No natural spawns near an active boss.
strings.cfg_6_loot__mode_help: Vanilla; Scaled (amounts times the star loot line); Rolled (table rolled again per star); Amount (base chance kept, amounts scale); Curated (only listed drops).
strings.cfg_6_loot__extra_roll_chance_help: Rolled: percent chance of an extra roll for each star, by star; the last entry repeats.
strings.cfg_6_loot__max_extra_rolls_help: Rolled: most extra rolls per kill; 0 means no limit.
strings.cfg_6_loot__amount_per_star_help: Amount: percent more of each successful drop per star.
strings.cfg_6_loot__amount_per_star_bosses_help: Amount mode: percent more of each successful boss drop per star.
strings.cfg_6_loot__defer_to_dropnspawn_help: Loot steps aside while DropNSpawn is installed.
strings.cfg_6_loot__seasonal_meat_help: Host or server: while Solstice seasons are on, meat and hide from creatures use that season's published rate. Spring and summer drop less, fall and winter drop more, between one quarter and three times the usual amount. One item stays one item. Trophies, feathers, fangs, scales and coins stay as they are. Off, missing Solstice, or seasons turned off keeps today's drops. The next kill uses the current rate.
strings.cfg_6_loot__seasonal_wood_help: Host or server: while Solstice seasons are on, wood from felled trees uses that season's published rate. Spring and summer drop less, fall and winter drop more, between one quarter and three times the usual amount. One piece stays one piece. Off, missing Solstice, or seasons turned off keeps today's wood. The next tree uses the current rate.
strings.cfg_7_luck__persist_counters_help: Bad-luck counters are saved with the character, per world.
strings.cfg_7_luck__attribute_to_killer_help: Counters advance for the player who made the kill, whichever machine owns the creature.
strings.cfg_7_luck__tame_credit_range_help: Meters within which a tame's kill credits a player.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__karma_mode_help: How Karma answers heavy killing in an area. KarmaLevelAndEnforcer: creatures there gain levels and Enforcers come; KarmaLevelOnly: levels only; EnforcerOnly: Enforcers only; Off: no Karma.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__max_enforcers_per_sector: Most active Enforcers in one 3 x 3 Karma neighborhood.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__dungeon_enforcer_delay_h: Seconds between the dungeon warning and the Enforcer.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__enforcer_abandon_despawn: Seconds without a player near before an Enforcer leaves; 0 never.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__block_enforcer_while_bos: No Enforcer while a boss is active nearby.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__block_karma_while_boss_a: Kills add no Karma while a boss is alive nearby.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__block_karma_while_enforc: Kills add no Karma while an Enforcer is alive nearby.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__block_omen_during_cooldo: Omen cannot summon an Enforcer during the region's cooldown.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__block_spawns_near_enforc: No natural spawns near a living Enforcer.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__health_per_extra_player_: Percent more creature health per nearby player after the first.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__damage_per_extra_player_: Percent more creature damage per nearby player after the first.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__max_players_for_scaling_: Most nearby players counted for scaling.
strings.cfg_8_pressure__yield_scaling_to_help: Comma list of plugin GUIDs of other mods that set the game's multiplayer difficulty. While one is installed, the three per-player settings above leave the game's values alone. CreatureManager is always honored.
strings.cfg_10_display__trait_names_above_creatu: Shows a creature's mutations, boss aspects and modifiers once each on their own smaller line above its health bar name, and the name itself without trait words. Applies to ordinary creature health bars; boss bars keep the trait words in the name. Needs Show Trait Names. Your personal client display setting; it never changes what other players see. Default: on.
strings.cfg_10_display__nameplate_distance_help: Meters at which nameplates show; 0 keeps the game's.
strings.cfg_10_display__modifier_icon_layout_hel: How modifier icons sit above a creature. FixedCategorySlots: each category keeps its own place, leaving gaps; RightPacked: icons line up from the right with no gaps.
strings.cfg_10_display__effect_density_help: Share of cosmetic trait effects drawn; warnings always show.
strings.cfg_10_display__small_star_size_help: Size of a small star above creature names, as a multiple of the game's star size (1 = same, 1.3 = 30% larger).
strings.cfg_10_display__large_star_size_help: Size of a large star (worth five stars), as a multiple of the game's star size.
strings.cfg_10_display__show_stolen_items_help: Icon of what a Thieving creature holds.
strings.cfg_10_display__show_devoured_creatures_: Icon of what a Devouring creature ate.
strings.cfg_10_display__icon_size_help: Size of stolen and devoured icons.
strings.cfg_10_display__sneak_inspect_help: While crouching, looking at a creature shows its resistances and weaknesses.
strings.cfg_10_display__damage_board_seconds_hel: Seconds the boss damage board stays open.
strings.cfg_10_display__boss_hints_help: Your own display choice: show the boss hints to you. Works only while the server's Bosses / Boss Hints is on.
strings.cfg_10_display__show_karma_under_minimap: Karma line inside the minimap's bottom-right corner. The world tier for Mantle's square beside the minimap always shows.
strings.cfg_10_display__palette_help: Star color per mutation as Name=#RRGGBB, comma separated.
strings.cfg_10_display__lore_window_key_help: Key that opens the Wildblood page of the Compendium. Empty (default): no key; the Meadworks menu (F8, Esc > Meadworks) lists the lore.
strings.cfg_10_display__lore_window_pad_chord_he: Gamepad chord that opens the Wildblood page of the Compendium. Empty: none.
strings.cfg_11_recap__record_deaths_help: Keep a recap of my last deaths.
strings.cfg_11_recap__recap_key_help: Key that opens the death recap. Empty (default): no key; the Meadworks menu (F8, Esc > Meadworks) lists the recap.
strings.cfg_11_recap__death_notice_help: After a death, say how to open the recap.
strings.cfg_13_horde__horde_help: More naturally spawned creatures, each weaker. Bosses, events, dungeon/camp spawners and tame creatures are excluded.
strings.cfg_13_horde__spawn_multiplier_help: Natural spawn groups and maximum populations; their own loot scales inversely.
strings.cfg_13_horde__creature_health_multiplier: Tagged natural creatures' health, composed with existing stars. Applied when they load.
strings.cfg_13_horde__creature_attack_multiplier: Attack damage multiplier for naturally spawned creatures that Horde added. Changes apply to them right away.
strings.cfg_14_ai__player_target_switching_help: When a creature looks for a target, it sometimes switches to another hostile player it can sense. Separate from stars and traits; the machine that controls the creature decides.
strings.cfg_14_ai__player_target_switch_interval: Minimum seconds between attempts, including failed or unreachable selections. Changes restart pending attempts.
strings.cfg_14_ai__player_target_switch_chance_h: Chance per attempt. Zero disables extra selection.
strings.cfg_14_ai__player_target_hold_duration_s: Seconds a creature keeps the player it switched to before its next target search may replace them. 0 disables holding. The game still drops targets it loses, and hunting or provoked creatures keep their own priorities.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__drop_multipliers_help: Cheat. The three drop multipliers below act. Off whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__creature_drop_multiplier_: While Drop Multipliers is on: multiplies non-trophy creature drops after the loot mode.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__boss_drop_multiplier_help: While Drop Multipliers is on: multiplies boss drops on top.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__trophy_drop_multiplier_he: While Drop Multipliers is on: multiplies trophy amounts when a trophy drops.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__lucky_kills_help: Cheat. Every bad-luck-protected row drops on each kill; counters are untouched.
strings.cfg_12_cheats__creature_commands_help: Cheat. Enables the admin commands wildblood spawn, purge and karma.
